trigger: Only if dam_secret_told == authority. Guard squad arrives during the black start.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Headlights on the access road. A Guard squad, eight of them, rifles up. Strand is with them.

nodes.speaker: strand
nodes.text: Easy. Everyone easy. Ms. Kowalczyk, we brought the relay kit. And dinner.

nodes.speaker: strand
nodes.text: I bring guns to everything now. Show me what you need, Mr. Lindqvist.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Someone startles. A private fires once at the powerhouse door. Hank goes down.

nodes.speaker: strand
nodes.text: CEASE FIRE. Cease— God. Medic! Ms. Kowalczyk, I'm sorry. I am.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Hank grabs your sleeve. 'Exciter first. Then sync. Don't— let them make it a fort.'

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He's gone before the medic gets the coat open.
